parse.title: UFC Fight Night: Cortes-Acosta vs. Walker
parse.text: UFC Fight Night: Cortes-Acosta vs. Walker (also known as UFC Fight Night 293 and UFC Vegas 124) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on November 7, 2026, at the Meta Apex in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States.[2]
